Templates a new paywall or onboarding flow can start from: 'voidhash paywall create --template
<template>' starts its design as one.

Usage:
  voidhash paywall template <command> [flags]

Commands:
  list       List the templates, with the products each one sells.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash paywall template <command> --help' for more about a command.
